speaker: Doctor
text: DIAGNOSIS READY: Congenital Cytomegalovirus (CMV) Infection. The lack of prenatal care, maternal fever history (implied risk), and newborn status strongly suggest TORCH infection, specifically CMV, which is the leading non-genetic cause of sensorineural hearing loss and microcephaly in newborns. I await the ultrasound results to confirm findings like intracranial calcifications or periventricular cysts, though the clinical picture is highly suggestive.
